description: drive one agent view through "steps" in order; each step's result must equal "expect". ops: log (entries), heartbeat (heartbeat, nonce, at_ms), certificate (certificate, at_ms), status (at_ms). at_ms is the agent's monotonic clock, except for certificate, where it is wall-clock time. The fleet is "fleet"; the agent is agent_id / instance_id.

cases.name: no heartbeat yet, then running, then the dead-man rule
behind the log, then caught up
the history: halted, resumed, a2 halted (a1 runs)
a heartbeat for an older log size is fine
fork: the coordinator shows another head
a halt delivered directly, whose seq another certificate takes: it stays until a later resume
a halt delivered directly that the log then applies: the state holds it
a direct halt of this agent
replay of an applied halt is ignored
a log entry that does not verify
heartbeats do not move time backwards
